response.sql: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALB) - AVG(L.TP) AS alb_tp, AVG(L.APTT - L.PT) AS ap FROM Patient P JOIN Laboratory L ON L.ID = P.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb_tp) AS alb_tp, AVG(ap) AS ap FROM p GROUP BY SEX), m AS (SELECT AVG(ap) AS mean_ap FROM s) SELECT AVG(s.alb_tp) AS avg_alb_tp, AVG(s.ap) AS avg_aptt_pt, AVG(s.ap - m.mean_ap) AS excess FROM s, m WHERE s.ap > m.mean_ap
